artifact_lifecycle_matrix.producer_or_authority: M0-12 task executor within the compiled packet
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: The workflow derives candidate and delivery-head identities for every run
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Committed skill guidance plus deterministic contract and integration tests
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.authenticity: Protected repository history; guidance grants no authority
transitions_and_recovery: A product candidate may advance only after active commands pass; a delivery head may inherit that evidence only after deterministic promotion-tail validation.

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Canonical M0-12 packet and repository policy
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Product candidate, delivery head, active gates, review inventory, and promotion artifacts
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Stop on scope drift, failed commands, invalid promotion tails, or P0/P1 findings

authorization_boundary_trace.input: Skills, workflow docs, tests, and task lifecycle artifacts
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Do not modify product packages, workflows, examples, or accepted product evidence

authorization_boundary_trace.input: Scope, invariants, gates, and stop conditions
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Do not broaden the process task or weaken non-waivable requirements
Do not infer authority from the skill, roster, or ambient credentials

authorization_boundary_trace.input: Plan, repository, contract, and skill validation commands
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Do not skip a failed active gate or rerun full gates solely for a valid promotion tail

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Protected delivery workflow plus current-run maintainer grant
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Push, PR, review batch, merge, and post-merge checks
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: The implementation role performs no GitHub write, merge, or provider action

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Repository CI and protected branch state
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Latest delivery-head checks and post-merge status
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Local guidance cannot fabricate or change external status

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Only a canonical promotion tail may inherit exact product-candidate evidence.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: State, ledger, evidence, and generated progress form the complete delivery-head delta.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: A missing required promotion artifact blocks inheritance.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: Evidence bound to another product candidate blocks promotion.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: A product or test change in the tail blocks promotion.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: An extra out-of-policy path blocks promotion.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Restore the exact candidate, rebuild the promotion tail, and rerun the small tail check.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: A changed delivery head invalidates the tail check and CI result.

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Review feedback is batched without weakening blockers.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: One review inventory produces one bounded repair and exact-candidate revalidation.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: An incomplete review inventory cannot justify delivery-debt classification.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: Prior-candidate findings cannot settle a changed product candidate.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: Any P0, P1, or non-waivable finding blocks regardless of P2 classification.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: A claimed standalone P2 without explicit maintainer classification blocks.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Fix blockers in one batch; after a completed repair generation, record at most one standalone P2 as delivery debt.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: New feedback is classified against the exact current product candidate and delivery head.

attack_cases: A promotion tail changes product or test bytes.
An unclassified P2 or skill text is presented as maintainer authority.
Candidate evidence is reused after a product change.
Review batching omits a P0, P1, or non-waivable finding.
Promotion precedes exact-candidate validation or required reviews.
A prior product candidate is substituted beneath current promotion artifacts.

residual_risks: Automated review can still surface a genuinely blocking issue after push; P0 and P1 remain blocking.
The workflow trusts the local developer runtime and installed skills and is not a security sandbox.
